questions.q: What definition of justice does Socrates propose?
questions.why: Socrates defines justice as minding one's own business.

questions.q: According to Plato, how many parts compose the soul?
questions.why: He outlines a tripartite theory of the soul.

questions.q: Which part of the soul is associated with city rulers?
questions.why: Reason is the golden part governing just laws.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a 'noble lie' in Plato's city?
questions.why: A noble lie is used to keep harmony.
